rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=5, img_sr=0.0005, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-5, ONE-KNOB change vs iter-4 (the BEST base: SSIM 0.9732, PSNR 38.21 dB). Knob: image-domain bilateral cascade DEPTH img_n_bf 3 -> 5 (12 -> 18 trainable BF params). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-4 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0005 TIGHT, seed=42, proj sigmas at Wagner-abdomen solver defaults). NUMBERS / TRAJECTORY: iter-1 (defaults) 0.9720 / 38.17 dB; iter-2 (proj sigmas tuned) 0.9680 / 37.90 dB -- proj-domain tuning HURT, reverted; iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.0005 TIGHT) 0.9723 / 38.19 dB; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3 at tight img_sr) 0.9732 / 38.21 dB -- +0.0009 SSIM, DEPTH HELPS once sigma is tight. hr=0 throughout (all under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP / PSNR baseline). FAILURE MODE addressed: PSNR still pinned just below the LD-FBP baseline; the 12-param 3-deep edge-preserving image cascade lifted SSIM but is not yet expressive enough to push PSNR over baseline. WHY THIS KNOB NOW: img_n_bf is the CONFIRMED working lever once img_sr is tight (iter-4 proved 1->3 lifts +0.0009). The design doc (solver_dual_ddomain_bilateral_n2i.md Design considerations) states the image-domain stack 'readily differentiates into a multi-scale cascade (BF1 mild + tight sigma_r, BF2 wider, BF3 widest)' -- a genuine multi-scale denoiser. On demo_dl bilateral, img_n_bf 3->5 is a proven productive step (hr 0.7465->0.7705 / mayo_campaign_state.md demo-bilat 1->3->5: 0.67->0.75->0.77). At tight img_sr=0.0005 each BF in the stack is edge-preserving, so a 5-deep cascade adds finer multi-scale expressivity instead of compounding blur. HYPOTHESIS: deepening the edge-preserving image cascade 3->5 at tight img_sr=0.0005 lifts SSIM/PSNR above iter-4's 0.9732 toward the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline, mirroring the demo-bilat 3->5 gain (0.7465->0.7705). If it SATURATES (SSIM within +-0.0005 of iter-4, PSNR within +-0.05 dB), breast bilateral N2I is at its ~0.973 SSIM / 18-param structural ceiling -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view FBP. WALL: image-domain BF cost scales ~5/3 vs iter-4 (still a small fraction of the FBP-adjoint-dominated per-step cost); step budget unchanged (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-4 ran 448 s, so well under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
